_comment: Snapshot of the Google Business Profile reviews, taken by hand on 2026-09-10 because the Places API is not wired up yet. Dates are absolute so the page can render '2 months ago' correctly forever instead of freezing whatever Google said the day it was copied. js/reviews.js prefers /api/reviews when that is configured and falls back to this file, so the section is never empty. Reviews marked feature:false still count toward the total but are not shown as cards.
